deliverables: Fund builders expected to improve Cardano monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL
Require funded projects to track core KPIs including monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions
Continue development of KPI tracking, including movement from self-reported tracking toward live on-chain Cardano data
Operate review, feedback, voting, milestone validation, and disbursement processes through a smart contract-governed DAO
Return unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds to the Cardano Treasury
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with treasury withdrawal administered by an independent dRep DAO council and multisig before milestone-based disbursement
request.what: Cardano Builder DAO requests treasury funding for an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed DAO funding mechanism intended to allocate capital to Cardano builders based on KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is designed to allocate capital to builders who can improve Cardano's monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
The DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, with Version 1 using public self-reported KPI tracking and Version 2 moving toward live on-chain Cardano data.
Funded projects are required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Round 1 included 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, funded 20 companies, achieved 83% governance participation, and distributed 5,541,335 ADA.
Round 2 added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and achieved 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.
The DAO created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based review, and executed treasury withdrawals on-chain.

Official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions and KPI tracking tied to on-chain activity, users, and TVL.

Treasury funds will be held by an independent dRep DAO council in separate auditable accounts, not delegated to a stake pool operator, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option before milestone-based disbursement from an independent multisig.
The CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after its first two governance rounds, with a transaction link provided.

summary: The proposal seeks 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue a smart contract-governed builder funding mechanism focused on KPI-linked ecosystem growth, with claimed prior funding rounds, milestone administration, and unused-fund repayment practices.
